linear-algebra.dimension_mismatch: Assuming matrix multiplication is commutative (AB == BA) or neglecting inner dimension matching.
linear-algebra.null_space_confusion: Confusing the row space dimension with the null space dimension instead of using the Rank-Nullity theorem.
linear-algebra.eigenvector_scaling: Thinking eigenvectors change direction when scaled by a scalar.

neural-networks.gradient_saturation: Believing higher learning rates fix vanishing gradients in saturated sigmoid neurons.
neural-networks.bias_omission: Thinking weights alone can shift decision boundaries away from the origin without bias terms.
neural-networks.backprop_order: Believing layer activations update immediately during the forward pass.

attention-mechanisms.dimension_scaling: Forgetting the sqrt(d_k) denominator in scaled dot-product attention causing vanishing softmax gradients.
attention-mechanisms.causal_masking: Applying bidirectional attention during autoregressive generation leading to label leakage.

sql.where_vs_having: Using WHERE to filter aggregated GROUP BY metrics instead of HAVING.
sql.join_multiplication: Neglecting Cartesian products when joining on non-unique foreign keys without proper grouping.

statistics-fundamentals.p_value_fallacy: Interpreting p-value as the probability that the null hypothesis is true.
statistics-fundamentals.correlation_causation: Assuming strong Pearson correlation implies direct causal relationship.

javascript.closure_scope: Assuming var declarations inside loops create separate block scopes.
javascript.event_loop_sync: Expecting asynchronous callbacks to execute synchronously in microtask queue order.

react-fundamentals.state_mutation: Directly mutating state variables instead of passing new immutable objects to setState.
react-fundamentals.effect_dependencies: Omitting used variables from useEffect dependency arrays leading to stale closures.
